decisions.decision: Keep Binance's PoR target, actual snapshot time, publication deadline and withdrawal-restoration target as separate fields.
decisions.reason: The 12-hour snapshot target elapsed at 07:33 UTC; no result was located by 11:07 UTC; publication is due by November 2; the 34-hour withdrawal target is November 1 at 05:33 UTC.

decisions.decision: Do not extrapolate CoinDesk's Binance 14 Ethereum reserve-wallet crosswalk to the five XRPL source wallets or XRP reserve coverage.
decisions.reason: Binance14 is an Ethereum address; no same-address or official XRP reserve-set crosswalk is established.

decisions.decision: Do not admit Binance XRP exchange-reserve decline as a bullish outflow feature until source addresses and causes are reconciled.
decisions.reason: Theft, customer withdrawals, cold-wallet migration and internal reclassification have different economic meanings; current provider universes differ.

decisions.decision: Keep derivatives series provider-specific and label long/short as account ratios.
decisions.reason: OI universe and contract aggregation differ; account ratios are not notional exposure.

decisions.decision: Keep ETF flow observations as context-only until holdings/AUM and execution timing are independently available.
decisions.reason: Alpha Finance reports flows only through October 29 and explicitly lacks fund AUM and holdings.

decisions.decision: Keep entity sentiment exploratory-only until time-window filtering, syndication deduplication, source-independence adjustment and entity-level relevance checks are implemented.
decisions.reason: Current all-history scores are not time-local and may count repeated or unrelated articles.

decisions.decision: Enforce baseline chronology trained_through_utc <= computed_at_utc <= data_cutoff_utc <= issued_at_utc.
decisions.reason: A baseline computed before its latest training data can leak future information even when both values precede the forecast cutoff. Guard and regression test are in PR #1410; exact-head CI and fail-closed gate passed.

decisions.decision: Do not issue directional XRP forecasts until point-in-time features, fixed-horizon outcomes, walk-forward benchmarks, calibration and drift checks are executed.
decisions.reason: PR #1410 is a ledger contract, not a trained or calibrated model.

decisions.decision: Do not merge or dispatch repository safety proposals automatically.
decisions.reason: Cross-analysis, scheduler and token-rotation writers remain active on main; their safer PRs are open/draft/unmerged. Preserve user approval boundary.

decisions.decision: Keep nine-platform collaboration status DESIGN ONLY until each provider is separately authenticated and a test handoff is verified.
decisions.reason: No external platform credentials or live handoffs were tested in this run.
